::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 14th 1890  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Sir,
I was born on the 11th of August 1823, in this village, and have lived here all my life being wholly educated by my parents at home.

My [father](people/person_1631.qmd) belonged to an old Devonshire family, and was an officer in the 52d regiment.

I have written and published ever since about 1849 or 1850

Yours truly
C M Yonge
